---
title: Line fit
config:
  dataset: datasets/points@latest
  fit: runs/fit@latest
  evaluation: runs/evaluate@latest
---

The pipeline publishes a dataset, fits a line to it and evaluates the fit.
`make` passes the exact versions it produced as config overrides.

```{python}
#| label: fig-fit
#| fig-cap: Samples and the fitted line.
#| echo: false
import cairn
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from IPython.display import display

rows = cairn.use(cfg.dataset).value.load()
model = cairn.use(cfg.fit).value
rmse = cairn.use(cfg.evaluation).value["rmse"]
figure, axis = plt.subplots(figsize=(7, 3.3))
axis.scatter([row["x"] for row in rows], [row["y"] for row in rows], s=8)
axis.axline((0, model["intercept"]), slope=model["slope"], color="black")
axis.set(xlabel="x", ylabel="y")
figure.tight_layout()
display(figure)
plt.close(figure)
```

The fitted line has slope `{python} f"{model['slope']:.2f}"` and intercept
`{python} f"{model['intercept']:.2f}"`, with a root-mean-square error of
`{python} f"{rmse:.3f}"` (@fig-fit).
